academy_content.stage_1_lesson_intro: Welcome to the First Protocol. Stage 1 is not about tools; it's about the **Mental Shift**. You cannot build a decentralized empire with a centralized slave mind.
academy_content.stage_1_lesson_secret: Rich people don't trade time for money; they trade **Systems** for money. Your goal in this Academy is to reach a velocity where your system generates $1 every single minute, 24/7, while you sleep. That is the point of absolute freedom.
academy_content.stage_1_lesson_body:
Most people view the world through the lens of 'Hard Work'. They think that if they work 8 hours, they deserve 8 hours of pay. This is the **Linear Trap**. In the P2P world, we use **Exponential Leverage**.

Your P2PHub node is a digital asset. Unlike a physical job, it doesn't get tired. It doesn't need to eat. It just needs 'Attention'—the global currency of the 21st century. Your first mission is to stop thinking of this as a 'referral program' and start thinking of it as your private, global liquidity bank. 

You are no longer an employee. You are a **Protocol Owner**. Every partner you invite is a sub-node in your private bank. Every card they swipe is a transaction fee that flows directly to YOU. Understanding this 'Ownership' is the difference between earning coffee money and earning a fortune. Your mind must be unshakeable, your vision must be global, and your discipline must be surgical. Welcome to the exit. Let's begin.
academy_content.stage_1_lesson_outro: Your mission: Delete the word 'Job' from your vocabulary. Repeat the $1/Minute mantra. You are the Commander now.
academy_content.stage_1_lesson_viral_rule: The Rule of Sovereignty: If you are not building your own empire, you are building someone else's. Choose your side today.
academy_content.stage_2_lesson_intro: The world is drowning in noise. Stage 2 is about **The Pattern Interrupt**—the psychological weapon used to break the scroll and force the human brain to focus on YOUR message above all others.
academy_content.stage_2_lesson_secret: You have exactly 1.2 seconds before a user scrolls past you. To win, you must trigger the **Amydala**—the lizard brain. Use High-Contrast visuals, weird facial expressions, or provocative text that 'Doesn't make sense' at first glance. If they don't stop, you already lost.
academy_content.stage_2_lesson_body:
The 'Scroll' is a hypnotic state. Most people don't even know they are doing it. A Pattern Interrupt is like a cold bucket of water. We use the **A-B-C Formula**:

**A - Aesthetic Shock:** Use colors that shouldn't be together (Acid Yellow vs Slate Blue). Use 'Action' shots—stuff that looks like it's moving.
**B - Bold Claim:** 'Why your bank account is a liability' or 'I found a legal glitch to $1/minute'. The claim must be huge, controversial, and direct.
**C - Curiosity Gap:** Give them the 'What' but hide the 'How'. Make their brain itch for the solution.

PRO members use **AI-Optimized Asset Overlays**. We take basic images and use our Studio (Stage 41) to add 'Glare', 'Distortion', and 'High-Visibility' badges that scream for attention. Remember: In the attention economy, 'Boring' is a crime punishable by poverty. Be loud, be weird, be unavoidable. You are the interruption, not the content.
academy_content.stage_2_lesson_outro: Your mission: Find an image that looks 'too safe'. Use the Viral Studio to make it 'pattern-breaking'. Use Acid Yellow. Post it and watch the CTR (Click-Through Rate) explode.
academy_content.stage_2_lesson_viral_rule: The Rule of the Thumb: He who stops the thumb, enters the wallet. Pattern interrupts are the only valid entry protocol for the elite.

setup.x_hint: 1. Visit developer.x.com. 2. Create project/app. 3. Enable OAuth 1.0a (Read/Write). 4. Generate & Sync keys here.
setup.tg_hint: 1. Add @{{bot_username}} to your channel. 2. Give 'Admin' rights with 'Post Messages' permission. 3. Enter Channel Username/ID.

steps.title: Step 1: Open X Developer Portal
steps.desc: Go to developer.x.com and sign in. Click on 'Products' and choose 'Twitter API v2' (The Free or Basic version is perfect).

steps.title: Step 2: Create Your App
steps.desc: Click 'Create Project' and name it anything you like (e.g. 'Pintopay Studio'). Then, inside that project, create an 'App'.

steps.title: Step 3: Set Writing Power
steps.desc: Go to App Settings > Set up User Authentication. Choose 'OAuth 1.0a'. Switch permissions from 'Read Only' to 'Read and Write'. For the Website/Callback URL fields, just paste: https://t.me/pintopay_probot

steps.title: Step 4: Get Your 4 Magic Keys
steps.desc: Go to the 'Keys and Tokens' tab. Click 'Regenerate' for Consumer Keys and 'Generate' for Access Tokens. Copy all 4 codes: API Key, API Secret, Access Token, and Access Secret.

steps.title: Step 5: Connect to P2PHub
steps.desc: Paste those 4 codes into the API Setup box here and click 'SAVE SETTINGS'. You're now ready to post to X!

steps.title: Step 1: Create a Channel
steps.desc: Click 'New Channel' in your Telegram app. Give it a cool name and a profile picture.

steps.title: Step 2: Add Your Bot Helper
steps.desc: Go to your channel settings > Administrators > Add Admin. Search for @{{bot_username}} and add it.

steps.title: Step 3: Give Permission
steps.desc: When adding the bot, make sure 'Post Messages' is turned ON (green). This lets the bot send your viral posts for you.

steps.title: Step 4: Link to P2PHub
steps.desc: Copy your channel's public link (like @mycoolchannel) and paste it into the API Setup box here. Click Save and you're done!
